key_insight: OrthoPilot is a large language model–based clinical AI system designed to integrate longitudinal hospital data and external medical knowledge to support evidence-based musculoskeletal care across the full treatment pathway.
clinical_relevance: If validated and deployed responsibly, this approach could help clinicians make more consistent diagnosis, treatment, and rehabilitation decisions for complex musculoskeletal patients over time.
method: Built a system that autonomously retrieves imaging, lab, pathology, and order data in real time.
Created a specialist-validated benchmark from real-world electronic health records covering 1,000 disease codes.
Evaluated performance in a reader study, a prospective complex-case study, and an 8-month randomized deployment.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that OrthoPilot outperformed 81 orthopaedic physicians in a reader study, improved full-chain management success by 10.6% in 1,870 complex cases, and increased cumulative cases per bed by 9.7% during an 8-month deployment of 8,240 inpatients.
watch_item: Results come from a specific musculoskeletal setting, so broader use will require careful validation, workflow integration, and monitoring for safety and generalizability.
